name: Craftsman CMECS600 / S160
blurb: Oregon prints one chain for CMECS600 and S160: 16″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 56 drive links (S56).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints CMECS600 and S160 on one line with chain S56: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. CMECS600 is printed again later, alone, with the same S56 row. S160 is not the S165. CMXGSAMNN4216 is on the first of those lines and also in a separate multi-length block, so this page does not cover CMXGSAMNN4216. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S56 under CMECS600 and S160, and again under CMECS600 alone: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
